subject.title: fix(ui): keep Workboard detail drawer actions in parity

question: Should maintainers use this PR as the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99957, or land the already proof-positive duplicate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100838 instead?
rationale: Two proof-backed open PRs now implement the same remaining Workboard drawer action-parity fix, and the current PR also has a protected maintainer label, so ClawSweeper should not choose or close branches automatically.

options.title: Land this PR as canonical
options.body: Use this branch for the action-parity fix after refreshing exact-head checks, then close or supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100838 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100319.

options.title: Land the duplicate proof-positive PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100838 if maintainers prefer that implementation shape, then close this PR and the older needs-proof candidate as superseded.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: Hold all drawer action-parity PRs if maintainers want a different drawer action design or owner direction before merge.

recommendation.title: Land this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use this branch for the action-parity fix after refreshing exact-head checks, then close or supersede https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100838 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100319.
